name: A voice beneath the mound

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: At a mound of earth inside Roland’s Doom, Velinde’s specter appears. Her words convey failure, worgen beyond control, and the loss of Elune’s Scythe; she wonders whose hand now directs its power. The scene lets the seeker hear her grief, but it does not show the moment of her death or name a new bearer. The mine has yielded the missing priestess’s testimony and confirmed that the artifact is no longer with her. Its path after that loss remains unseen.
